$comment: Invariant ids the P2 task `p2-g8-bake` turns green in tools/coursekit. The integrate task merges these into docs/invariants-owned.json.

validators.V7: every renderable string has audio, every audio file has a string, durations are sane — tools/coursekit/src/coursekit/validators/audio.py::string_audio_join
validators.F2: INV-PACK-15 — codec, bitrate and total bytes against the declared budget, all three pipelines — tools/coursekit/src/coursekit/validators/audio.py::audio_budget

heldWithoutAnInvariantId: The cast decisions in content/es/cast.yaml are asserted, not trusted: test_cast.py::test_the_cast_records_r15_as_a_decision_not_a_table_cell reads the file and fails if D-CAST-ES-01 (the locale claim) or the INV-AUD-08 decision is deleted. A recorded founder decision that a later edit can silently remove is not recorded.

The Kokoro Spanish roster is asserted against the REAL voice pack when the tts group and the weights are present (test_cast.py::test_kokoro_ships_three_spanish_voices_and_the_cast_knows_it), so a fourth Spanish voice re-opens D-CAST-ES-02 with a red test rather than by luck.

R7 is enforced in code, not in a comment: tts/piper.py::build raises ForbiddenSource for ja — the same exception the ingest allow-list raises for TED2020, because it is the same NC decision. test_cast.py::test_piper_refuses_japanese.

The loudness meter is calibrated against BS.1770's own point (a 1 kHz sine at -20 dBFS RMS reads -20 LUFS, and the derived 48 kHz coefficients reproduce the published table to eleven places). An uncalibrated meter reports a number every clip agrees with and no standard does.
The pinned Kokoro weights are checked by size and sha256 before the model is loaded. This caught a truncated 44 MB download on its first real run.

notOwnedHere.INV-AUD-01: audio availability resolved at session generation — packages/core, P3
notOwnedHere.INV-AUD-02: an unavailable audio control greys with a reason — UI, P3
notOwnedHere.INV-AUD-03/04/07: story karaoke alignment and keypoints — P6
notOwnedHere.INV-PACK-55: the pack detail screen rendering the engine fields — P4 UI, though the manifest fields it renders are written here
